sources.title: Bernini-R S2V: Speech-Driven Video Generation on ByteDance's Bernini-R
sources.snippet: rzgar releases Bernini-R-S2V, a speech-to-video fine-tune that adds Wan2.2 S2V audio-driven lip-sync capabilities to ByteDance's Bernini-R model, with dedicated ComfyUI custom nodes and multiple precision variants.
